cases.sentence: Из Троады мы отплыли прямо в Самофракию и оттуда на ___ в Неаполь.
cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

cases.sentence: Из Неаполя мы продолжили путешествие в Филиппы, римскую колонию и ___ той части Македонии.
cases.explain: «главный город» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

cases.sentence: Среди них была одна по имени Лидия, из города Фиатиры, которая торговала дорогими ___.
cases.explain: «пурпурными тканями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

cases.explain: «большой доход» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

cases.sentence: Когда ее хозяева поняли, что у них пропал источник дохода, они схватили Павла и Силу и поволокли их на площадь к ___.
cases.explain: «городским властям» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas, and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

cases.sentence: Внезапно произошло такое ___, что поколебались основания тюрьмы.
cases.explain: «сильное землетрясение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

cases.sentence: В тот же ___ тюремщик промыл им раны и сразу же был крещен, он сам и все домашние его.
cases.explain: «ночной час» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

cases.sentence: Наступил день, и ___ послали своих служителей в тюрьму с приказом:
cases.explain: «городские начальники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

cases.sentence: Служители доложили об этом ___, и когда те услышали, что Павел и Сила римские граждане, то испугались.
cases.explain: «городским начальникам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

cases.sentence: Служители доложили об этом городским начальникам, и когда те услышали, что Павел и Сила ___, то испугались.
cases.explain: «римские граждане» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,
